scope: One AR171 canonical-short, zero-initial-state CPU comparison. No AR1 change, accelerator AOT, QNN runtime, phone, generation campaign or app activity.
quantization: Unchanged architecture-aware block32 Q4 ONNX baseline; CPU embedding dequantization and FP32 graph interfaces. No weights or quantization change.
inputs: Identical 41 serialized arrays: CPU-dequantized embeddings for all171 exact short IDs, INT64 positions0..170, causal FLOAT32 mask and38 zero initial states. No historical qnn-net-run position files.
outputs: All38 state tensors and22 logit chunks retained separately for unchanged baseline, derivative, and baseline debug-output copy.

criteria.coverage: Exactly60 original outputs per route with identical shapes/dtypes and bound input hashes.
criteria.instrumentation: Every original debug-copy output must reproduce the unchanged baseline bit-for-bit before captured query/key operands can support same-state probes. Otherwise stop and report discrepancy; no retry.
criteria.finite: Report every nonfinite value and every tensor delta; do not discard finite or nonfinite output because of argmax or threshold disagreement.
criteria.numeric_tolerances: Both allclose thresholds are descriptive, not numerical/quality acceptance or an automatic AOT gate. Bitwise identity is mandatory only for instrumentation equivalence.
criteria.next_gate: Review actual numerical observations before any separately authorized AOT, regardless of CPU agreement. No speedup or quality-equivalence conclusion.

fp16_proxy: For each of8 baseline attention sites use identical captured FP32 query/key operands, round ingress to IEEE FLOAT16; compare round16(round16(FP32-accumulate(Q16*K16))*0.125) against round16(FP32-accumulate(round16(Q16*0.125)*K16)). Retain both score arrays; report every cast's finite/subnormal/nonzero-to-zero/overflow counts and score deltas (full tensor and causal unmasked entries). NumPy FLOAT32 BLAS accumulation, gradual underflow, no emulation of actual HTP kernels, fusion, accumulator, rounding or flush-to-zero policy.

resources.scratch: New exclusive directory under experiment .local on /dev/mapper/cryptoroot, never tmpfs. External weights referenced read-only and hash-checked before/after, not copied or rewritten.
